newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas puts sell note on Accor.
newsitem.headline: Paribas puts sell note on Accor.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets issued on Wednesday a sell note on hotelier Accor, following Tuesday's profit warning from resorts group Club Mediterranee which it was considered to resemble.

The note from Paribas analyst Nigel Reed said Accor resembled Club Med in being highly geared, reliant on capital gains, subject to high operational gearing and dependent on France as its major market.
Accor was down 1.56 percent at 630 francs at 1330 GMT, while the market was down 1.23 percent. Club Med slumped 17.96 percent to 326.50 francs, after earlier being suspended limit down.
